name: NRW Holdings Limited
summary: NRW Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides diversified contract services to the resources and infrastructure sectors in Australia. It operates through four segments: Civil; Mining; Minerals, Energy & Technologies (MET); and Electrical, Mechanical (HVAC), Infrastructure & Technology (EMIT).
